title: Growth & Strategy Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Language requirement: German (C1+) OR Mandarin Chinese (equivalent professional fluency). Professional working proficiency in English required.
 About MAOMAO MAOMAO is building one of Germany's most exciting Asian food e-commerce businesses, combining online grocery, content, community, social commerce and our own consumer brands.
 With over 200,000 followers across social media, an established e-commerce business and a growing team, we're ready for our next stage of growth.
 We're looking for an exceptionally driven, analytical and entrepreneurial Growth & Strategy Manager to work directly with our founders, drive marketing performance and help scale MAOMAO.
 This isn't a traditional marketing role. We're looking for someone who thinks like an entrepreneur, takes ownership and has the potential to grow into a leadership position.
 What You'll Do Drive Growth: Identify opportunities to increase revenue, customer acquisition, conversion, average order value and customer retention.
 Scale TikTok Shop & Social Commerce: Help grow one of our most important sales channels by improving livestream performance, affiliate partnerships, promotional strategies and conversion.
 Own Marketing Performance: Monitor KPIs across TikTok Shop, livestreaming, social media, e-commerce and campaigns. Turn data into actionable improvements.
 Drive Marketing Execution: Take ownership of marketing priorities, coordinate our existing marketing and content team, monitor progress and ensure initiatives deliver measurable results.
 Lead Strategic Projects: Take ownership of growth initiatives, product launches and commercial experiments from idea to execution.
 Work With the Founders: Help make strategic decisions, challenge assumptions and turn ambitious goals into measurable results.
 Develop as a Leader: Take ownership of cross-functional projects from day one, with the opportunity to progressively assume direct team leadership based on performance.

title: Account Executive, Portworx - Strategic Accounts - Telco (EMEA)
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Pure Storage is seeking a Strategic Accounts Account Executive to accelerate growth of the Portworx platform across Strategic Telco accounts in EMEA. You will own a small number of named Telco customers and prospects, build and execute multi year account plans, and drive platform adoption with a focus on business outcomes such as resilience, risk reduction, faster application delivery, and operational efficiency.

You will work closely with cross functional teams across Pure and Portworx, including Systems Engineering, Customer Experience, Marketing, Partner teams, Product, and field leadership. This is a high impact individual contributor role with a strong emphasis on strategic planning, disciplined execution, and customer intimacy.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and grow a portfolio of named Strategic Telco accounts, delivering against annual and multi year revenue targets.
  • Build and execute account plans that map buying centres, application priorities, Kubernetes roadmaps, and transformation programmes.
  • Develop executive relationships across CIO, CTO, CISO, Head of Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, SRE, and Application leaders.
  • Lead complex sales cycles from discovery through close, including security, risk, procurement, architecture review, and legal processes common in Telco…
